subject: You get the 101% and the
author: PhotonKitsune
body:
You get the 101% and the Carbon Uberschall 8 when you do complete two sets of online-freeburn-challenges (no timed-challenges needed for that). The game does not care if you, for example, complete all for 2-players and then all for 3-players. You could also have only completed those for 8 and 7 players and it'd count. To do them, either join a freeburn online or host one yourself. The number of players defines which challenges are available. If you only want to make those for 2 players, host a freeburn, invite a friend, set the game's access to "Invite only" and then do the challenges with your friend. If you are playing Burnout for PC, then you can add me. Name's in my signature.

Online-records on your road-rules are just a comparison between you and your friends. Single-player-times and -scores do count, what kind of hurts me... Most people just hack their showtime-scores to 100m or 200m to have them done. Of course, that costs this person's friend some fun at beating the friends-scores.
